description: Authoring UI + categoryStore wiring (TASK 2 + TASK 3 screen side). Wires every category picker to the new categoryStore (CategoryManageScreen tab, AddEditProductScreen, WebProductScreen, ProductListScreen chips, ImportExportScreen reactive names), and adds supplier picker + options/variant-grid authoring (with validation and always-include save keys) to AddEditProductScreen (mobile) and WebProductScreen (web). Depends on FEAT-001 (categoryStore, ProductOption/ProductVariant/supplierId types) and should follow FEAT-002 (shares the same screens' surrounding patterns, avoids index/merge churn). Mostly lint + manual RN verification.
steps: src/screens/product/CategoryManageScreen.tsx: replace `const [categories,setCategories] = useState<Category[]>(MOCK_CATEGORIES)` (line 29) and the local add/edit/delete category branches with categoryStore — `const categories = useCategoryStore(st => st.categories)` and call addCategory/updateCategory/deleteCategory, mirroring exactly how the brand tab already uses useBrandStore + addBrand/updateBrand/deleteBrand. Use getCategoryProductCount(id) for the category count badge (like getBrandProductCount for brands). Keep Thai labels + existing empty state.

src/screens/product/AddEditProductScreen.tsx (category): replace `MOCK_CATEGORIES.filter(c => c.status==='active')` (line 535) with `getCategories().filter(c => c.status==='active')` from categoryStore; remove the MOCK_CATEGORIES import if now unused.
src/screens/product/ProductListScreen.tsx (chips): replace the MOCK_CATEGORIES spread (line 148) with getCategories() from categoryStore.
src/screens/web/WebProductScreen.tsx (category): wire its category picker/options to getCategories() from categoryStore.

src/screens/product/ImportExportScreen.tsx: replace module-level `ACTIVE_CATEGORY_NAMES = MOCK_CATEGORIES...` (line 100) and the `MOCK_CATEGORIES.find(...)` at line 201 with in-component reactive derivation via getCategories() (compute inside the component/handler, not a module const).

src/screens/product/AddEditProductScreen.tsx (supplier): add a supplier picker reading getSuppliers() from supplierStore — Supplier has NO status field, do NOT filter by status; include a '— ไม่ระบุ —' option; Thai empty state ('ไม่มีข้อมูล') when the store is empty; selection optional. On select set supplierId + supplierName.

src/screens/product/AddEditProductScreen.tsx (options/variants): add an Options editor (add/remove option name + values; option name required & unique; each option needs >=1 value) that auto-generates an editable variant grid = cartesian product of option values; each variant row edits sku/barcode/price?/stockQty. Validate: stockQty non-negative integer (default 0); if price entered price>=0; variant barcodes unique within this product. Invalid rows block save with a Thai inline error (<Alert type="error"> / existing error style). Use design-system tokens/components; 44px touch targets.

src/screens/product/AddEditProductScreen.tsx (handleSave, line 201): the saved ProductMaster payload must ALWAYS include keys `options`, `variants`, `supplierId`, `supplierName` (even when empty array / undefined) so editing can CLEAR them. Keep existing audit logAction on price change.
src/screens/web/WebProductScreen.tsx (authoring): mirror the supplier picker + options/variant grid + validation + always-include-keys save rule inside the web product modal, using WebColors tokens.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run lint` reports no type errors.

No screen reads MOCK_CATEGORIES directly for pickers/chips/import anymore; all go through categoryStore (getCategories()/useCategoryStore). A category added via CategoryManageScreen appears in AddEditProductScreen + WebProductScreen + ProductListScreen chips without reload.

AddEditProductScreen and WebProductScreen expose a supplier picker (no status filter) and an options/variant-grid editor with Thai validation errors; saving a product always writes options/variants/supplierId/supplierName keys (clearable).
categoryStore unit test still passes: `npx vitest run src/store/__tests__/categoryStore.test.ts`.
findings:
LANDED (feat/vmat worktree, committed locally, NOT pushed).

CATEGORY STORE WIRING (no screen reads MOCK_CATEGORIES for pickers/chips/import anymore):
- CategoryManageScreen.tsx: category tab now uses `useCategoryStore(st => st.categories)` + addCategory/updateCategory/deleteCategory, mirroring the brand tab. Count badge + delete-guard use getCategoryProductCount(id). Removed MOCK_CATEGORIES import + the local useState list.
- AddEditProductScreen.tsx (mobile): cat PickerModal items = `getCategories().filter(c => c.status==='active')`. MOCK_CATEGORIES import removed.
- ProductListScreen.tsx: chips data = `[all, ...useCategoryStore(st=>st.categories)]` (reactive). MOCK_CATEGORIES import removed.
- ImportExportScreen.tsx: module-level ACTIVE_CATEGORY_NAMES const DELETED; validateRow computes active names via getCategories() each call; applyImport resolves category via getCategories() inside the handler. MOCK_CATEGORIES import removed.
- WebProductScreen.tsx: MasterScreen category tab mirrors the brand tab via categoryStore (getCategories/getCategoryProductCount/addCategory/updateCategory/deleteCategory + categoryRefreshKey re-render); list filter chips use `categoryStore.useCategoryStore(st=>st.categories)` (reactive); ProductFormModal category dropdown + categoryName-on-save use `categoryStore.getCategories()`. MOCK_CATEGORIES import removed from the file.

SUPPLIER PICKER (Supplier has NO status — not filtered):
- Mobile AddEditProductScreen: new PickerField 'ผู้จำหน่าย' + PickerModal with items `[{id:'',name:'— ไม่ระบุ —'}, ...getSuppliers()]`; selection optional; sets supplierId + supplierName. PickerModal gained optional `showEmpty` prop that renders a Thai 'ไม่มีข้อมูล' empty state (passed `getSuppliers().length === 0`).
- Web WebProductScreen: new 'ผู้จำหน่าย' dropdown in ProductFormModal reading getSuppliers(); '— ไม่ระบุ —' option; Thai 'ไม่มีข้อมูล' when list empty; sets supplierId.

OPTIONS / VARIANT-GRID AUTHORING (both screens):
- Options editor: add/remove option (name + comma-separated values). Editing options regenerates the variant grid = cartesian product of option values, PRESERVING existing variant rows whose optionValues match (keyed by JSON of optionValues).
- Variant grid rows edit sku / barcode / price? / stockQty. stockQty coerced to non-negative integer (Math.max(0, Math.floor(..))).
- Validation (Thai inline error, blocks save): option name required & unique, each option >=1 value (optionNameError also disables save on web via canSave, and short-circuits validateVariants on mobile); stockQty must be non-negative integer; price (if entered) >=0; variant barcodes unique within the product. Errors render in a danger-token inline banner (Colors.dangerLight/Colors.danger mobile; WebColors.dangerLight/danger web) — project has no <Alert> UI component, so used the existing inline error-banner style per the rule's 'existing error style' allowance.

ALWAYS-INCLUDE SAVE KEYS (clearable on edit): both handleSave payloads ALWAYS write `options` (=[] when none), `variants` (=[] when none), `supplierId` (undefined when none), `supplierName` (undefined when none). Mobile keeps existing price-change logAction; web onSave is Partial<ProductMaster> and now carries the 4 keys.

VERIFICATION: `npm run lint` => exactly 13 errors, ALL pre-existing baseline (BranchSelector/DatePicker/PermissionMatrixScreen/RoleManageScreen/WebUserStaffScreen/errorTracking) — ZERO in the 5 edited screens. `npx vitest run src/store/__tests__/categoryStore.test.ts src/utils src/engine/adapter/__tests__/cartAdapter.test.ts` => 4 files / 33 tests passed (categoryStore 5, cartProduct 6, priceResolver 8, cartAdapter 14).
